title: How a company's systems work from the inside
description: Analysis of systems integration, architecture, automation, AI and compliance, for the people who decide what to build, connect or change.
intro: We write about what we find inside companies that already run: an ERP that doesn't talk to the CRM, processes that depend on a spreadsheet, systems that have been in production for years and regulations with a deadline that force you to touch them. No hype, and with the level of detail needed to understand the problem and decide what to do about it.
